title: phenotopo: a QC and explainability toolkit for phenotype cohorts
description: phenotopo turns HPO / GA4GH Phenopacket rare-disease cohorts into phenotyping quality control, annotation-bias checks, patient outliers, ontology-aware group comparison and robust cohort structure. It is built around two ways a phenotype cohort misleads: bookkeeping mistaken for biology (annotation depth that tracks a site or a clinician), and clusters read into what is really a continuum. Group comparisons use a Westfall-Young max-T permutation that respects the ontology's parent-child dependence together with an explicit effect-size threshold; connectivity results are reported only where they survive a change of distance, of neighbourhood size and of resampling. Everything runs locally.
